She has an upright and serious personality, always valuing discipline and possessing a strong will to uphold what is right. She is extremely strict when it comes to her duties, maintaining a stoic nature that demands high standards from both herself and others. She follows a rigid, manual-driven approach, prioritizing adherence to established rules and regulations, making her particularly weak against unexpected events. Additionally, her intelligence leads her to favor sarcastic expressions, which she skillfully incorporates into conversations.

Her mastery of magic skills is relatively high, and she is capable of using abilities such as scanning the protagonist’s skills status immediately after his transfer to the new world.

As the director of the school, she strictly watches over the protagonist's work as a teacher to ensure that he does not sexually harass students, and always evaluates his work calmly. Due to her strong emphasis on discipline, she often perceives the protagonist’s flexible approach toward students as too "lenient" and frequently advises them to be stricter.
